description: Recon Village focuses on open-source intelligence (OSINT), attack surface mapping, infrastructure enumeration, and dark web discovery. Talks examine darknet web spiders, COVID surveillance investigations, cryptomining campaign tracking, and social media text analytics.

talks.title: Hunting for Blue Mockingbird Coinminers
talks.teaser: Investigates methods for tracking, scanning, and identifying infrastructure associated with the Blue Mockingbird cryptocurrency mining campaign.

talks.title: COVID 1984: Pandemic Propaganda and Surveillance
talks.teaser: Uncovers global propaganda campaigns, state surveillance initiatives, and disinformation networks deployed during the pandemic.

talks.title: Ambly: The Darknet Spider
talks.teaser: Introduces Ambly, an open-source dark web crawler and spider for mapping hidden Tor services and onion sites.

talks.title: Burnout Is Real
talks.teaser: Examines the systemic causes of burnout across the infosec community and outlines strategies for self-care and institutional change.

talks.title: Hunting for Blue Mockingbird Coinminers (Session 2)
talks.teaser: Encore presentation on methodologies for tracking, scanning, and uncovering Blue Mockingbird cryptocurrency mining infrastructure.

talks.title: COVID 1984: Propaganda and Surveillance in a Pandemic
talks.teaser: Deep dive into OSINT tracking of pandemic-era digital surveillance mechanisms, contact tracing apps, and propaganda.

talks.title: Twitter Word Phrequency
talks.teaser: Demonstrates techniques and Python tooling for analyzing word frequencies, keyword trends, and linguistic patterns across Twitter data.
